title: Data and code for: Evolved and Feldspathic Igneous Rocks on Mars: A Review of Detections, Formation Hypotheses, and Implications for Early Crustal Evolution
description: CRISM ratio and numerator spectra, region-of-interest definitions, Supplementary Tables 1 and 2 as CSV files, and the code that draws the spectral figures of Phillips, Viviano, and McSween (Space Science Reviews). Code is MIT licensed (LICENSE); data in data/ are CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA).
